content: Bu Karrimanjbun Nawu Kawohrnan Rowk.
Psalm 107
Ngurrimanjbu nawu Yawey, dja nakka nadjalmak duninjh. Nungka kandjalmarnedjare munguyh munguyh.
Kumekbe ngurriyimen, ngudda nawu Yawey ngunngehkeng kore nawu ngurriyidko ngundibongkarrmi.
Ngudda warridj nawu ngunmangi kore kubolkbubuyika ngurrikang kore koyek, dja mak karrikad, dja mak walem dja mak kakbi, dja ngunmornnameng rowk kore nuye.
Yikahwi bininj birribolkmayahmi kore kubolkdarleh birrirengehrey. Minj birribolkmayi kubolkmak kore birriyuwirrinj.
Bedda birrimarrwedoweni, mak birrikombukdoweni. Wanjh darnkih birriyakmeninj.
Wanjh birrikayhmi nawu Yawey kore kunyid kunwern benmarnewernmerrinj, dja nungka benngehkeng kore birridi kunnjilngwarre dorrengh.
Kaluk nungka benkanakang kore manbolhdjad, dja benkurrmeng kunred kunkimuk kore birriyonginj.
Mah, wanjh birridjalmanjbu nawu Yawey! Nungka wanjh kabendjalmarnedjare bu munguyh munguyh. Mak nungka kandjalmarnekurduyime kunmakkenh kadberre ngad nawu bininj rowk.
Nawu Yawey nungan kanbowonowon ngad nawu karrikombukdowe, dja mak kanworrkmiwon ngad bininj nawu karrimarrwe.
Yikahwi bininj birriyerrkani kore kubolkmunun dja wanjh birrikangewarreni bu kundowikenh. Bedda birribongdi dja birridukkayindi chains wirlmurrng dorrengh.
Kuhni benmarnekurduyimerranj kore bedda birriwokweng God nuye kunwok, dja birridjalwirrihmeng God nawu Nakimuk Duninjh bu benbengdayhkeyi.
Kunmekbekenh kunu God benkurrmeng kore birridurrkmirri kunrayek duninjh dja birridjalkangewarreminj. Bedda birringudjwarreminj dja birrimankang, dja minj nangale bininj benbidyikarrmeninj.
Kaluk birrikayhmeng kore nawu Yawey bu benbidyikarrmeng kore kunyid birrikarrmi. Dja nungka wanjh benngehkeng kore birrikangewarreni.
Benbebkeng kore kubolkmununbeh manbu kundowikenh, dja benmarnebakkeng wirlmurrng chains nawu bendukkang.
Mah, wanjh birridjalmanjbu nawu Yawey! Nungka wanjh kabendjalmarnedjare bu munguyh munguyh. Mak nungka kandjalmarnekurduyime kunmakkenh kadberre ngad nawu bininj rowk.
Yawey wanjh karrangbakbakke manbu manrayek duninjh, dja karradjke wirlmurrng steel bars ba kabenbebke bininj.

Yikahwi bininj wanjh birrimarnekarrebakkeng God nuye mankarre, dja munguyh birrikurduyimi kunwarre. Wanjh kunu birriyimerranj birribengwarr duninjh. Kunmekbekenh kunu wanjh kunrayek wernmerrinj bedberre.
Minj birridjareniwirrinj birringuyi manme, dja darnkih birridowimeninj.
Bu kuhni birribekkarrinj kore kunrayek kunwern birrikarrmi, wanjh birrimarnekayhmi nawu Yawey, dja nungka benngehkeng kore kunrayek bedberre.
Nungka wokmunkeweng nuye kunwok, dja kunu benmarnbom birrimekbe bininj kore birridowingalmeninj, dja mak benngehkeng kore kumidjbeh.
Mah, wanjh birridjalmanjbu nawu Yawey! Nungka wanjh kabendjalmarnedjare bu munguyh munguyh. Mak nungka kandjalmarnekurduyime kunmakkenh kadberre ngad nawu bininj rowk.
Bedda wanjh birriwo dja birrimarnekinje mayh nuye nawu Yawey ba bu kabirrimanjbun. Mak birriwayinin nuye kunnjilngmak dorrengh dja birrimulewa kore Yawey kakurduyime kunkimukkenh.
Yikahwi bininj birrireyi kabbala kore kurrula. Bedda birriweykani dja birribayahmi njalehnjale kore djarreh kurrula borledmikenh.
Bedda birrikurdunani Yawey kurduyimi kore kurrula kanjdji duninjh, dja wanjh birrikangebarrhmeng.
Wanjh Yawey wokdanj dja marnbom kunmayorrk kunkimuk manbu borokayhweng kurrula dja bowayhmi kaddum.
Kabbala bedberre wanjh wohbidbuni dja wohkolungi, kaddum dja kanjdji. Wanjh birriwernhkeleminj dja birriyimi bu birrikebngakmeninj.
Bedda wanjh birrimankani yiman bininj nawu kodjworromkang kunbangkenh. Minj birriburrbuyi bu baleh birrikurduyimeninj!
Wanjh birrikayhmeng nawu Yawey bu kuhnikenh, dja nungka benbidyikarrmeng kore birridjalnjilngwarreni.
Nungka wanjh ngurdkeng kunmayorrk ba yeleyeledj kurrula borokani dja minj yawoyhbobidbuyi kunkimuk.
Wanjh bedda birrinjilngmakminj bu birrikarrinj kurrula makminj. Dja nungka benkang kamak rowk bu birribolkmey kore kunbolk birridjareni.
Mah, wanjh birridjalmanjbu nawu Yawey! Nungka wanjh kabendjalmarnedjare bu munguyh munguyh. Mak nungka kandjalmarnekurduyime kunmakkenh kadberre ngad nawu bininj rowk.

Bedda wanjh birriburlumen Yawey kore kabirrimirndemornnamerren nawu bininj rowk nuye. Dja mak birriburlumen nuye kore kabirrimirnderri kabirriyolyolme nawu birrikihkimuk dja nawu kabirriwohrnawohrnan.
Nawu Yawey kabolkbuyikahwon, dja kamarnbun mankabo mankimuk bu kabolkyimerran kabolkdarlehmen. Nungka mak kaboyakwon kore kungad kambobebme, dja wanjh kurorre yiman kakombukdowen.

Yawey wanjh bennang bininj nawu birrihni kumekbe bu birriyimi kunwarre, wanjh kunmekbekenh nungka bolkbom kunbolk kore manme manwern djolengminj, ba bu djila wernmerrinj dja wanjh kulkwarreminj kumekbe.
Kaluk nungka kakurduyime kunbuyika warridj. Nungka kabolkmarnbun kore kubolkdarleh ba bu kabarlmiyindan manbowern dorrengh. Nungka mak kabolkmarnbun kubolkdarleh ba bu kungad kambobebme.
Nungka kabenkan bininj nawu kabirrimarrwedowen ba bu kabirridi kumekbe. Bedda wanjh kabirrirurrkmarnbun kururrkwern ba bu kabirridjaldi munguyh.
Wanjh bedda kabirrimimwe kore kabbal, dja kabirridudje manbu mankolhde manrakel. Dja wanjh manwern manme kadjolengmen ba bu kabirrimang.

Wanjh Yawey kabenmarnekurduyime kunmak bedberre, dja bedda wanjh birriwernhmirndewernmerrinj. Dja mak Yawey kabenmarnenahnan mayh nawern bedberre nawu kabirrikarrme dja minj kamirndeyahwurdmen nawu mayh.
Wanjh God nuye binihbininj birrimirndeyahwurdminj, dja birribuyika bininj bindibom dja bindibongkurrmeng. Kunrayek dja kunnjilngwarre bebmeng bedberre,
wanjh Yawey kabendung birrikihkimuk bininj nawu kabindiwarrewon nuye bininj. Dja benmarnbom birrimekbe birriwarre bininj bu kabirridjalrengehre kore kubolkdarleh manbu manbolhyak.
Dja benngehkeng bininj nawu birrimarladj, dja benmarnbom ba bu kabirrimirndewernmerren kore namud rowk bedberre. Bedda wanjh mirndewernmerrinj yiman mayh kamirndewernmerren.
Nawu birrimak bininj kabirrikurdunan kumekbe kore God kakurduyime, wanjh kabirrimarrmarr. Dja nawu birriwarre bininj wanjh kabirridjalwokyakmen!
Ngudda bininj nawu ngurrimayalimak, wanjh ngurridjalborlhmen rowk kore nawu Yawey kakurdukurduyime, dja ngurrimenmenbekkan kore nungka munguyh kandjalmarnedjare bulkkidj duninjh.
